During a 1964 tour of Australia, a famous Beatle came down with tonsilitis and couldn't tour. Rather than canceling the entire tour, the band hired a drummer by the name of Jimmy Nichol who was playing with a small rock band called the Shubdubs to fill in for the tour. He went from being an unknown to playing in the biggest rock band on the planet, and a celebrity overnight. 

Two weeks later the original drummer re-joined the band, and with zero fanfare (and without even speaking to the rest of the band who were asleep at the time) Jimmy was sent on a plane with 500 pounds, and a gold watch inscribed with thanks from the band, and faded into obscurity.
